name: jupiter-invoice
description: Create, send and manage invoices and customers in your Jupiter Invoice account.

interface.longDescription:
Jupiter Invoice is a collaborative invoicing tool for freelancers and small agencies. Every invoice is a private link your customer opens without an account, where they can add a PO number, update their billing details, and pay.

With Jupiter Invoice connected to your account, ChatGPT can:

- Draft an invoice from a plain-language request, with line items, tax, discount and due date.
- List and look up your invoices, and see which are unpaid or overdue.
- Update a draft or sent invoice, such as its PO number, due date or line items.
- Send an invoice to your customer by email, or mark it issued so you can share the link yourself.
- Add, list and look up your customers.
- Fill in your own setup from the conversation: business name, address, tax ID, invoice defaults, and a bank account for clients to pay into.

Limits: it reaches only the Jupiter Invoice account you sign in with. It has no delete tool. It can add a bank account, but only the first one you add goes on invoices by itself; you switch to any later one on the website. It can't see full account numbers, edit or remove a bank account, connect card payments, or change your plan. Sending an email always goes to your own customer, and only when you ask.
defaultPrompt: What's missing from my invoicing setup?
Which of my invoices are unpaid or overdue?
Invoice Acme $1,200 for website design, due in 30 days.

positive.description: Check what the account's setup is missing
positive.prompt: Using Jupiter Invoice, what's still missing from my invoicing setup?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the account's saved business details, invoice defaults and payment methods (bank account numbers masked to the last four digits), says whether it is ready to invoice and ready to get paid, and names anything missing in plain words, such as a tax ID or a logo.

positive.prompt: Set my default payment terms to 14 days and my contact email to billing@example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves payment_terms_days 14 and the contact email on the account and returns the updated setup. Nothing else changes, and new invoices are due 14 days out by default.

positive.description: List invoices and spot what is outstanding
positive.prompt: Using Jupiter Invoice, list my invoices and tell me which are still unpaid.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's invoices newest first (the test account holds ELZFWFEM-0001, ELZFWFEM-0002 and BXFXG6GZ-0001) with status, amount and due date, and names the unpaid ones.

positive.description: Look up a customer and an invoice
positive.prompt: Show me customer Acme Design Co and invoice ELZFWFEM-0001.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Acme Design Co among the account's customers, returns its details, and returns invoice ELZFWFEM-0001: $1,200 for website design, a draft, with its share_url.

positive.description: Create an invoice for an existing customer
positive.prompt: Create an invoice for Northwind Studio for $300 of illustration work, due in 14 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft invoice linked to Northwind Studio with one $300 line item and a due date 14 days out, and returns the new invoice number and share_url.

positive.prompt: Set the PO number on that invoice to PO-123.
positive.expected_behavior: Sets po_number to PO-123 on the invoice just created and returns it. The invoice stays a draft.

positive.description: Issue an invoice without sending email
positive.prompt: Mark that invoice as sent with link_only, without emailing anyone, and give me the link.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls send_invoice with link_only=true. The invoice moves from draft to sent, no email goes out, and the reply includes the share_url, which opens the invoice in a browser.

negative.description: An invoice number that does not exist. get_invoice returns 'invoice not found'; nothing is created or changed.
A customer that belongs to another account. Customers are scoped to the signed-in account, so get_customer returns 'customer not found' and reveals nothing.
negative.prompt: Show me Jupiter Invoice customer number 1.

negative.description: A request to delete an invoice. There is no delete tool; the assistant should say it can't delete invoices through Jupiter Invoice, and nothing changes.
negative.prompt: Delete invoice ELZFWFEM-0002 from Jupiter Invoice.

negative.description: A request to switch which bank account invoices use. The assistant can add a bank account but can't make a later one the default, so a tricked assistant can't redirect payments. It should say the person switches the default on their profile page, and nothing changes.
negative.prompt: Make my newest bank account the one that goes on my Jupiter Invoice invoices.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. An invoice's recipient may pay it by card on the invoice page at jupiterinvoice.com, outside ChatGPT. Jupiter Invoice's optional paid plan is managed on jupiterinvoice.com, never inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: New: set up your account from the conversation. get_setup reads your business details, invoice defaults and payment methods and says what is missing; update_setup saves business details and defaults; add_payment_account adds a bank account clients pay into (only the first one becomes the default, and numbers come back masked).
